Wrath R4.new: Causes 37 Nature damage to the target.
Wrath R4.old: Causes 38 Nature damage to the target.
Wrath R4.note: Rank 4 of 6. Base 38 to 37; growth per level 0.9 to 0.6.

Fireball R5.new: Hurls a fiery ball that causes 120 Fire damage and an additional 16 Fire damage over 8 sec.
Fireball R5.old: Hurls a fiery ball that causes 108 Fire damage and an additional 16 Fire damage over 8 sec.
Fireball R5.note: Rank 5 of 6. Base 108 to 120; growth per level 1.5 to 1.4.

Frostbolt R5.new: Base damage 104 Frost (rank 5, level 26 to 30), plus 1.3 per level.
Frostbolt R5.old: Base damage 95 Frost (rank 5, level 26 to 30), plus 1.5 per level.
Frostbolt R5.note: Read from SpellEffect: Frostbolt's tooltip template uses a variable our resolver cannot fill.

Arcane Missiles R3.new: Launches Arcane Missiles at the enemy, causing 47 Arcane damage each second for 5 sec.
Arcane Missiles R3.old: Launches Arcane Missiles at the enemy, causing 44 Arcane damage each second for 5 sec.
Arcane Missiles R3.note: Rank 3 of 4. Per missile: base 44 to 47; growth per level 0.5 to 0.4.

Smite R4.new: Smite an enemy for 60 Holy damage.
Smite R4.old: Smite an enemy for 59 Holy damage.
Smite R4.note: Rank 4 of 5. Base 59 to 60; growth per level 1 to 0.7.

Lesser Heal R3.note: Rank 3 of 3. Base 141 to 163; growth per level 1.6 to 1.2.

Heal R2.note: Rank 2 of the Heal ranks under the cap. Base 405 to 375; growth per level 3.2 to 2.9.

Lightning Bolt R5.new: Casts a bolt of lightning at the target for 82 Nature damage.
Lightning Bolt R5.old: Casts a bolt of lightning at the target for 72 Nature damage.
Lightning Bolt R5.note: Rank 5 of 6. Base 72 to 82; growth per level 0.7 to 0.5.

Shadow Bolt R4.new: Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy, causing 58 Shadow damage.
Shadow Bolt R4.old: Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy, causing 56 Shadow damage.
Shadow Bolt R4.note: Rank 4 of 5. Base 56 to 58; growth per level 0.9 to 0.8.

t:WARRIOR:Furious Precision.new: Increases your chance to hit with off-hand attacks by 10%.

t:WARRIOR:Lingering Rage.new: Increases the time before your Rage begins to decay after leaving combat by 10 sec.

t:WARRIOR:Gore Drinker.new: Your Enrage, Berserker Rage, Bloodrage, Death Wish, and Bloodthirst abilities cause your next 6 melee attacks to restore 1.0% of your maximum Health.

t:WARRIOR:Improved Cleave.old: Reduces the Rage cost of your Cleave ability by 3.

t:WARRIOR:Precision.old: Improves your chance to hit by 3%.

t:WARRIOR:Toughness.old: Increases your Armor value from items by 10%.

t:WARRIOR:Iron Will.new: Reduces the duration of Stun and Fear effects inflicted on you by 15%.
t:WARRIOR:Iron Will.note: Moved from Fury row 2 to Protection row 1.

t:WARRIOR:Bloodthirst.new: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 45% of your Attack Power plus 30 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.
t:WARRIOR:Bloodthirst.old: Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 35% of your Attack Power plus 30 and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.

t:WARRIOR:Dual Wield Specialization.new: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 25% and the Rage generated by your off-hand attacks by 50%.
t:WARRIOR:Dual Wield Specialization.old: Increases your off-hand weapon damage by 25% and chance to hit with off-hand attacks by 10%.

t:WARRIOR:Raging Blows.new: Reduces the Rage cost of your Cleave and Whirlwind abilities by 3.
t:WARRIOR:Raging Blows.old: Causes your Whirlwind to also strike with your Off Hand weapon, and reduces the Rage cost of your Cleave ability by 2.

t:WARRIOR:Booming Voice.new: Increases the area of effect of your Shouts by 50% and reduces their Rage cost by 25%.
t:WARRIOR:Booming Voice.old: Increases the radius of your Battle Shout and Demoralizing Shout abilities by 50%.

t:WARRIOR:Unbridled Wrath.new: Gives you a 60% chance to generate 1 additional Rage when you deal melee damage with a weapon.
t:WARRIOR:Unbridled Wrath.old: Gives you a 60% chance to generate 1 additional Rage when you deal melee damage with a weapon. This effect is increased to 2 Rage for two-handed weapons.

t:WARRIOR:Blood Craze.new: Regenerates 3% of your total Health over 6 sec after being the victim of a critical strike or suffering more than 60% of your maximum Health from a single attack.
t:WARRIOR:Blood Craze.old: Regenerates 3% of your total Health over 6 sec after being the victim of a critical strike, dealing damage with Bloodthirst, or suffering more than 60% of your maximum Health from a single attack.

t:WARRIOR:Improved Slam.new: Reduces the global cooldown and cast time of your Slam ability by 0.50 sec. In addition, Slam no longer interrupts or delays your melee swing and Slam's cooldown is reduced by 6.0 sec.
t:WARRIOR:Improved Slam.old: Reduces the global cooldown and cast time of your Slam ability by 0.50 sec. In addition, Slam no longer interrupts or delays your melee swing and Slam's cooldown is reduced by 3.0 sec.

t:WARRIOR:Flurry.new: Increases your melee attack speed by 25% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.
t:WARRIOR:Flurry.note: Now requires Death Wish (was Enrage), and sits one column left.

t:WARRIOR:Impale.new: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your abilities by 20%.

Berserker Rage.new: The warrior enters a berserker rage, becoming immune to Fear and Incapacitate effects and generating extra rage when taking damage. Lasts 10 sec.

Whirlwind.new: In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing weapon damage from both melee weapons to each enemy.
Whirlwind.old: In a whirlwind of steel you attack up to 4 enemies within 8 yards, causing weapon damage to each enemy.

Demoralizing Shout.new: Reduces the melee attack power of all enemies within 10 yards by 49 for 45 sec.
Demoralizing Shout.note: Rank 1. Every rank gained a threat effect: 11 / 19 / 27 / 35 / 43, plus 0.8 per level.

Intimidating Shout.new: The warrior shouts, causing the targeted enemy to cower in fear. Up to 5 enemies within 8 yds will flee in fear. Lasts 8 sec.
Intimidating Shout.old: The warrior shouts, causing the targeted enemy to cower in fear. Up to 5 total nearby enemies will flee in fear. Lasts 8 sec.

Piercing Howl.new: Causes all enemies within 0 yds to be Dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.
Piercing Howl.old: Causes all nearby enemies to be Dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.
Piercing Howl.note: The client now prints "within 0 yds": the template reads a second radius the spell lacks. Its radius is still 10 yards.

Spearing Strike.new: A brutal attack that deals 40% weapon damage. Deals an additional 80% weapon damage against Giants, Dragonkin, and mounted targets. Mounted targets are dismounted.
Spearing Strike.old: A brutal attack that deals 40% weapon damage, plus an additional 80% weapon damage against Giants, Dragonkin, and mounted targets.

Retribution Aura R5.new: Causes 20 Holy damage to any creature that strikes a party member within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.
Retribution Aura R5.old: Causes 30 Holy damage to any creature that strikes a party member within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.

Retribution Aura R2.new: Causes 8 Holy damage to any creature that strikes a party member within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.
Retribution Aura R2.old: Causes 12 Holy damage to any creature that strikes a party member within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.
Retribution Aura R2.note: Rank 2, the rank from level 26 to 35. Ranks 1 to 5: 7/12/18/24/30 to 5/8/12/16/20.

t:PALADIN:Redoubt.new: Damaging melee attacks against you have a 10% chance to increase your chance to block by 20%. Lasts 10 sec or 5 blocks.
t:PALADIN:Redoubt.note: Unchanged between 70170 and 70291. Build 70170 (October 1) cut it from 6/12/18/24/30% to 4/8/12/16/20%, as Blizzard's October 1 notes say.

Holy Shield.new: Increases chance to block by 30% for 10 sec, and deals 110 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active. Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat. Each block expends a charge. 4 charges.
Holy Shield.note: Rank 1. Unchanged between 70170 and 70291. Build 70170 (October 1) raised the block chance from 20% to 30%, as Blizzard's October 1 notes say.

t:PALADIN:Reckoning.new: Gives you a 40% chance to gain an extra attack after Blocking a melee attack and a 100% chance to gain an extra attack after being the victim of a non-periodic critical strike. Cannot occur more often than once every 1.5 sec.
t:PALADIN:Reckoning.old: Gives you a 40% chance to gain an extra attack after Blocking a melee attack and a 100% chance to gain an extra attack after being the victim of a non-periodic critical strike.

Vindication buff.note: The buff the Vindication talent applies. The talent itself still says 1/2/3%.

Judgement of Justice.note: One of the Judgement texts that were blank in 70170.

Infusion of Light.new: Reduces the cast time of your next Holy Light spell by 1 sec.

Seals.new: Fill the Paladin with various divine enhancements. You currently have access to:
Seals.note: A spellbook flyout. Not in any skill line yet.

t:HUNTER:Expose Prey.new: Your attacks against targets with Hunter's Mark have a 10% chance to activate your Mongoose Bite for 10 sec.
t:HUNTER:Expose Prey.old: Your attacks against targets with Hunter's Mark have a 10% chance to activate your Mongoose Bite for 5 sec.

Unleashed Fury.new: Increases the damage done by your pets and hawks by 20%.
Unleashed Fury.note: Same text; the effect moved from a percent modifier to a flat modifier (aura 108 to 107).

Improved Concussive Shot.new: Gives your Concussive Shot a 20% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.
Improved Concussive Shot.note: Same text; the proc entry's chance went from 20 to 100, so the talent's own points now set it (inferred).

Improved Wing Clip.new: Gives your Wing Clip ability a 20% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.
Improved Wing Clip.note: Same text; the proc entry's chance went from 4 to 100.

Freezing Trap.note: Rank 3. Was blank in 70170, and the spell lost the word "Effect" from its name.

Aspects.new: Take on the aspect of various creatures, enhancing your combat abilities in different ways. You currently have access to:
Aspects.note: A spellbook flyout. Not in any skill line yet.

Furious Howl.new: The wolf howls, increasing the melee attack power of all party members within 15 yards by 82. Lasts 1 min.
Furious Howl.note: Rank 4 of the wolf's howl. Unchanged between 70170 and 70291. Build 70170 (October 1) cut it from 136 to 82 (rank 3: 100 to 60), the 40% Blizzard's September 24 notes announced.

t:PRIEST:Penance.new: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 42 Holy damage to an enemy, or 126 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.
t:PRIEST:Penance.old: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 81 Holy damage to an enemy, or 184 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.
t:PRIEST:Penance.note: Rank 1, the rank under the cap. Mana 100 to 150.

Touch of Weakness.new: The next melee attack against the caster will cause 8 Shadow damage and reduce the attacker's melee attack power by 43 for 2 min.

Weakened Soul.new: Cannot benefit from Power Word: Shield.

Water Shield buff.new: Attacks and spells used against you and your critical heals restore 2% of your maximum mana. 1 charges.
Water Shield buff.old: Attacks and spells used against you and your critical heals restore 0.67% of your maximum mana. 3 charges.
Water Shield buff.note: The buff text. The 15 sec category cooldown is gone from the spell.

Mana Tide Totem.new: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 12 sec that restores 88 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards.

Totemic Recall.new: Returns your totems to the earth, giving you 25% of the mana required to cast each totem destroyed by Totemic Recall.
Totemic Recall.note: Spell 39104 is new in 70291. The Forever copy 1323420 still prints 0%.

Earth Totems.new: Provide the Shaman with earth enchanted totems. You currently have access to:
Earth Totems.note: One of seven totem flyouts (two Earth, one Air, two Fire, two Water).

Ancestral Fortitude.new: Increases your armor value from items by 8%.

Chilled.new: Movement slowed by 30% and time between attacks increased by 25%.

Demonic Brand.new: Your Searing Pain generates less threat and brands the target. Your pet's next attacks against the target deal Fire or Shadow damage based on the pet. If Shadow damage is dealt, it has high threat.
Demonic Brand.old: Your Searing Pain generates less threat and brands the target. Your pet's next attacks against the target generate high threat and deal Fire or Shadow damage based on the pet.
Demonic Brand.note: The client's wording with its numbers left out: the template uses variables our resolver cannot fill.

Summoning Disorientation.note: A 10 sec stun. Nothing in the client says what casts it.

Thorns R6.new: Thorns sprout from the friendly target causing 18 Nature damage to attackers when hit. Lasts 10 min.
Thorns R6.old: Thorns sprout from the friendly target causing 22 Nature damage to attackers when hit. Lasts 10 min.

Thorns R3.new: Thorns sprout from the friendly target causing 9 Nature damage to attackers when hit. Lasts 10 min.
Thorns R3.old: Thorns sprout from the friendly target causing 11 Nature damage to attackers when hit. Lasts 10 min.
Thorns R3.note: Rank 3, the rank from level 24 to 33. Ranks 1 to 6: 4/9/11/13/16/22 to 3/6/9/12/15/18.

t:DRUID:Natural Instinct.new: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your melee abilities by 20% and increases your spell healing by 25% of your Intellect.
t:DRUID:Natural Instinct.old: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your melee abilities by 20%.

t:DRUID:Thick Hide.new: While in Bear Form, Cat Form, Dire Bear Form, or Moonkin Form, you gain 3 additional base Armor per level and another 2.00 base Armor for each point of defense skill beyond five times your level. This amount can be further increased by multipliers from those forms.
t:DRUID:Thick Hide.note: Same text. Its armor effect now grows 3 per level (levels 1 to 60).

t:DRUID:Furor.new: Gives you a 100% chance to gain 10 Rage when shapeshifting into Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. Shapeshifting into Cat Form restores 100% of the Energy you had when last in Cat Form, plus 10 Energy per sec spent outside Cat Form, up to 100 Energy. Bear Form and Dire Bear Form forfeit this Energy and halt its restoration while active.
t:DRUID:Furor.old: Gives you a 100% chance to gain 10 Rage when you shapeshift into Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. When you shift into Cat Form, you will regain 100% of the Energy you had when you were last in Cat Form, plus 10 Energy for each second you spent not in Bear Form, Cat Form, or Dire Bear Form, up to a maximum of 100 Energy.

Wolfshead Helm.new: You gain an additional 5 Rage from activating Enrage and an additional 5 Energy from activating Shifting Power.
Wolfshead Helm.old: You gain an additional 5 Rage from activating Enrage and an additional 20 Energy from activating Shifting Power.

Demoralizing Roar.new: The druid roars, decreasing nearby enemies' melee attack power by 46. Lasts 30 sec.
Demoralizing Roar.note: Rank 1. Every rank gained a threat effect: 8 / 16 / 26 / 34 / 42, plus 0.8 per level.

Will of the Forsaken.new: Instantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects.
Will of the Forsaken.note: Same text. Its three dispels became 100 ms immunities, so it works while asleep or charmed.

Violet Meditation.new: Chance on damaging spell to allow 15% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting for 15 sec. Mana regen amount is doubled in Strongholds and Cities.
Violet Meditation.note: 4-piece bonus. Its chance is not in the client.

Summon Arcane Elemental.new: Chance on damaging spell to summon an Arcane elemental to aid you in combat.
Summon Arcane Elemental.note: 5-piece bonus. Summons creature 277729 for 20 sec. Its chance is not in the client.

Archmagister's Wisdom.new: Increase experience gained from slaying Undead by 10% for 5 min.
Archmagister's Wisdom.note: The use effect of an unnamed neck in the probable Dalaran boss-loot block.

Arcane Explosion NPC.new: Sends out a blast wave of magic, inflicting 57 to 73 Arcane damage to nearby enemies and silencing them for 4 sec.
Arcane Explosion NPC.note: No class owns this copy (inferred: an NPC spell).

Mana Void.new: 2 sec cast. 90 Arcane damage to enemies within 60 yards of the caster, and a 5 sec silence.
Mana Void.note: No tooltip text: read from SpellEffect and SpellCastTimes.

Krol'dok Resolve.new: Chance on block to heal for 14 to 23. Healing is doubled in Strongholds and Cities.
Krol'dok Resolve.note: As the game prints it: the heal (spell 1324296) is 18 with 0.5 variance.

Ogre Dominance.new: Taking damage has a high chance to increase your Stamina by 1 for 30 sec, stacking up to 20 times.

Defias Juggernaut.new: Melee attacks have a chance to increase your Critical Strike chance by 2% for 20 sec. This effect is doubled in swamps.

Collapsing Star.new: Anara Chillwind channels the grace of Elune, infusing random enemies with the might of a star and inflicting 10 Arcane damage every 2 sec. Upon removal, a collapsing star is formed. Enemies within the star suffer 15 Arcane damage every 2 sec and have their movement speed reduced by 10%.
Collapsing Star.old: Anara Chillwind channels the grace of Elune, infusing random enemies with the might of a star and inflicting 10 Arcane damage every 2 sec. Upon removal, a collapsing star is formed. Enemies within the star suffer 15 Arcane damage every 2 sec and have their movement speed reduced by 35%.
Collapsing Star.note: Anara Chillwind, Hyjal Summit. The text reads the aura's duration, which the client sets to -1 (no fixed length), so a template reader prints "for 0 sec"; we left those words out of both builds' text.

Lunar Venting.new: 35 Arcane damage inflicted to players within 20 yds.
Lunar Venting.old: 25 Arcane damage inflicted to players within 20 yds.

Dreamfall.new: Throws the Emerald Dream into turmoil, inflicting 5 Nature damage to all players every 2 sec.
Dreamfall.old: Throws the Emerald Dream into turmoil, inflicting 10 Nature damage to all players every 1 sec.
Dreamfall.note: Its encounter is not in its text (inferred: Nythus the Dreambound).

Rot.new: Diseases target for 24 Nature damage every 1 sec for 7 sec. Deals 2 times as much damage to Aquatic enemies.
Rot.old: Diseases target for 25 Nature damage every 1 sec for 7 sec. Deals 2 times as much damage to Aquatic enemies.

rebase.name: Fireball
rebase.cap: A level-30 character's best rank, rank 6, is unchanged at the cap. The cut lands on ranks 2 and 3 while leveling; ranks 4 and 5 rise.

rebase.name: Frostbolt
rebase.cap: Rises at the cap: rank 5 at level 30, 101 → 109.2 (inferred, Classic's per-level rule). Rank 2 is cut; ranks 4 and 5 rise.

rebase.name: Arcane Missiles
rebase.cap: Rises at the cap: rank 3 (capped at its level 28), 46 → 48.6 per missile (inferred). Ranks 2 and 3 rise per missile; rank 1 only grows slower.

rebase.name: Smite
rebase.cap: A level-30 character's best rank, rank 5, is unchanged at the cap. Ranks 2 and 3 are cut; rank 4 rises.
